SELECTED_INDEX: 8
CONFIDENCE: 0.64
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a typical aliphatic C–H stretching envelope at 2880–2964 cm⁻¹ with strong CH deformation near 1458 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), and multiple medium bands in the 800–1200 cm⁻¹ region consistent with C–O/C–C skeletal and C–O stretching modes expected for a vicinal diol. There is no strong carbonyl band (~1650–1750 cm⁻¹) or nitro antisymmetric stretch (~1520–1600 cm⁻¹), disfavoring carbamate/amide (2,7), acid (5), nitro (4), and carbonyl-containing (3). Candidate 8 (2,3-butanediol) best fits the aliphatic and C–O features; weak bands at 2727/2770 cm⁻¹ are consistent with overtones/combination bands rather than a distinct functional group.
